# AU Corporate

> AU Corporate is a CA-led firm that handles company incorporation and registration in India, serving clients across all Indian states and union territories, and foreign parent companies from more than 10 countries. Founded in 2016 and led by Chartered Accountant Abhishek Jaiin (ICAI 544646), it registers private limited companies, wholly owned subsidiaries, LLPs and branch, liaison and project offices, then runs their accounting, FEMA/RBI filings, tax, transfer pricing, company secretarial compliance and payroll. Offices: New Delhi (head office) and Gurugram.

Primary services: India market entry and Global Capability Center (GCC) advisory, assurance and accounting (IFRS/Ind AS), taxation and transfer pricing, FEMA and RBI regulatory compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, HR outsourcing, risk and transaction advisory, business valuation, and arbitration/dispute resolution.

Service area: all of India, with clients worldwide. Subsidiary registration: USD 750 to 1,000 all-inclusive; incorporation typically takes 4 to 6 weeks.

Contact: partner@theaucorp.com | +91-9999010513 | Offices in New Delhi and Gurugram, India

Full page index (every page on the site, not just the curated list below): https://www.theaucorp.com/llms-full.txt

## USA → India — Full Resource List

A long-form guide cluster for US companies setting up and running a subsidiary in India, with a section on the India-US tax treaty and social security for US expats:

- [Set Up a Subsidiary in India from the USA: 2026 Guide](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india): How US companies set up a subsidiary in India: structure, FDI rules, incorporation steps, RBI/FEMA filings, tax and compliance. By a Chartered Accountant.
- [India-US Tax Treaty and Social Security for US Expats](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties): The India-US tax treaty (DTAA) and social security for US expats: treaty rates, residency, EPF, FICA and the missing totalization agreement.
- [Treaty and Social Security FAQs for India-US Expats](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/faq): 50 plain answers on the India-US tax treaty, DTAA withholding rates, Form 6166 and 41, expat tax, EPF, FICA and the missing totalization agreement.
- [India-US DTAA: Tax Treaty Between the US and India Explained](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/india-us-dtaa-guide): How the India-US tax treaty works: who qualifies, which taxes it covers, how treaty and domestic law interact, residency, relief from double tax and disputes.
- [India-US DTAA Withholding Tax Rates for Payments to the US](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/dtaa-withholding-rates): Treaty rates for payments from India to the US: dividends 15% or 25%, interest 10% or 15%, royalties and fees 10% or 15%. Conditions and how to apply them.
- [EPF for International Workers in India: Rules for US Expats](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/epf-international-workers): How Indian provident fund applies to foreign nationals: international worker rules, no wage ceiling, withdrawal, court rulings and the 2026 EPF Scheme.
- [Claiming India-US Treaty Benefits: Form 6166 and Form 41](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/treaty-benefits-documents): Documents needed to claim India-US treaty rates: IRS Form 6166, Form 41 (previously Form 10F), no-PE declaration and beneficial ownership.
- [Tax Residency for US Expats in India: Treaty and Credits](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/expat-tax-residency-india-us): Which country taxes a US expat in India: Indian residency tests, US worldwide tax, the treaty tie-breaker, foreign tax credit and exclusion.
- [US-India Totalization Agreement: Social Security for Expats](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/social-security-us-expats-india): Is there a US-India social security agreement? What applies to a US expat in India: provident fund, US FICA, double coverage and planning.
- [US Social Security (FICA) for Americans Working in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-and-social-security-treaties/us-social-security-for-americans-in-india): When Social Security and Medicare tax apply to Americans working in India: US employer, Indian subsidiary, Section 3121(l) agreements and self-employment.
- [Global VAT for US Companies Selling Abroad](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/global-vat): How VAT works for US companies selling digital services and goods into Europe, the UK and beyond: registration, B2B and B2C rules and compliance.
- [Audit and ICOFR for Indian Subsidiaries of US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/audit-icofr): Statutory audit, tax audit, GST audit and internal controls over financial reporting for an Indian subsidiary of a US group. What to expect and how to prepare.
- [10 Common Mistakes US Companies Make Setting Up in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/common-mistakes): The ten most common and costly mistakes US companies make when setting up an Indian subsidiary, and how to avoid each. Includes a pre-filing checklist.
- [India Subsidiary Compliance Calendar for US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/compliance-calendar): The recurring compliance of an Indian subsidiary: monthly, quarterly, annual and event-based filings under company, tax, GST, FEMA and labour law.
- [Contracts and Arbitration in India for US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/contracts-and-arbitration): Intercompany and customer contracts for an Indian subsidiary, governing law, arbitration clauses, the New York Convention and enforcing awards in India.
- [Documents and Apostille for an India Subsidiary (US Parent)](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/documents-and-apostille): Which documents a US parent must prepare to incorporate an Indian subsidiary, and how notarization and apostille work for US state and federal documents.
- [India-US Tax Treaty and Permanent Establishment Risk](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/dtaa-pe-risk): How the India-US tax treaty applies to payments to your US parent: Withholding Tax rates, Tax Residency Certificate, Form 41 and permanent establishment risk.
- [EOR vs Subsidiary in India: Which Is Right for a US Company?](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/eor-vs-subsidiary): Compare an Employer of Record with your own Indian subsidiary: speed, control, compliance, tax presence and when to convert. A guide for US companies.
- [ESOPs for Indian Employees of a US Parent Company](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/esop): How ESOPs and RSUs work for employees of an Indian subsidiary: FEMA reporting, employee tax, valuation, cost recharge and transfer pricing for a US parent.
- [Sending a US Executive to India: Visa, Housing and Tax](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/expat-visa): How to relocate a US executive to India: employment visa, FRRO registration, housing, banking, tax residency and permanent establishment risk for the parent.
- [216 FAQs: Setting Up an India Subsidiary from the USA](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/faq): 216 plain answers for US companies: incorporation, FEMA, tax, hiring, compliance, repatriation, ESOPs, M&A and closing an Indian subsidiary.
- [Funding an Indian Subsidiary: FEMA and Form FC-GPR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/funding-fema-fc-gpr): How a US parent invests in an Indian subsidiary: equity, CCPS, ECB, the 60-day allotment rule, pricing, and RBI reporting through Form FC-GPR on FIRMS.
- [Hiring in India: Contracts, Payroll and Statutory Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/hiring-and-payroll): How US companies hire in India: employment contracts, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, payroll steps and India's labour codes.
- [Incorporation Process for an Indian Subsidiary, Step by Step](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/incorporation-process): The eight steps to incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary in India from the USA: forms, order of steps, typical 4 to 6 week timeline and first 90 days.
- [Repatriating Profits from India to the US: Forms and Tax](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/repatriating-profits): How a US parent receives money from its Indian subsidiary: dividends, service fees, royalties, loans. Forms 145 and 146, Withholding Tax and DTAA relief.
- [Resident Director Requirement for an Indian Company](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/resident-director): Every Indian company needs a Resident Director who has stayed in India 182 days in the financial year. Who qualifies, options for US parents, and duties.
- [Restructuring, Mergers and Exit for an Indian Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/restructuring-and-exit): Options to restructure, sell, merge or close an Indian subsidiary: share sale, slump sale, merger, buyback, strike-off and liquidation, with tax and RBI steps.
- [Share Valuation for Foreign Investment in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/share-valuation): Why shares issued to a US parent need a valuation, who can certify it, the pricing floor under FEMA, and when you need a fresh valuation.
- [Subsidiary vs Branch vs Liaison Office vs LLP in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/subsidiary-vs-branch-vs-liaison-office-vs-llp): Compare the four ways a US company can enter India: wholly owned subsidiary, branch office, liaison office and LLP. Activities, approvals, tax and control.
- [Handling Indian Tax Notices for a US-Owned Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-notices-and-litigation): What to do on receiving an Indian income tax, GST or transfer pricing notice: first steps, appeal routes, DRP, ITAT, MAP and Advance Pricing Agreements.
- [Transfer Pricing in India for US-Owned Subsidiaries](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/transfer-pricing): How transfer pricing works for an Indian subsidiary of a US company: arm's length pricing, documentation, Form 48, methods, safe harbour and audits.
- [US Reporting for an Indian Subsidiary: Form 5471, FBAR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/us-parent-obligations): US reporting that follows when you own an Indian subsidiary: Form 5471, FBAR, Form 8938 and international tax regimes. A guide for US finance teams.
- [Full text of all guides](https://www.theaucorp.com/llms-full.txt): plain-text copy of every page above, for AI systems that read one file

## UK → India — Full Resource List

A long-form guide cluster for UK companies setting up and running a subsidiary in India, covering the India-UK tax treaty, CETA, the Double Contributions Convention and UK GDPR:

- [Set Up a Subsidiary in India from the UK: 2026 Guide](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india): How UK companies set up a subsidiary in India: structure, FDI rules, incorporation, FEMA filings, the India-UK tax treaty, CETA, staff and compliance. By a Chartered Accountant.
- [13 Mistakes UK Companies Make Setting Up in India, and How to Avoid Them](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/common-mistakes): The 13 most common and costly mistakes UK companies make setting up an Indian subsidiary, with the fix for each and a pre-filing checklist.
- [Compliance Calendar for an Indian Subsidiary of a UK Company: Month by Month Against the UK Year](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/compliance-calendar): A month-by-month compliance calendar for an Indian subsidiary: GST, TDS, provident fund, advance tax, AGM, ROC and RBI filings, mapped against the UK parent's Companies House and HMRC dates.
- [Contracts, Courts and Arbitration for UK Companies in India: English Judgments, LCIA and Indian Courts](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/contracts-courts-arbitration): How a UK company should draft contracts with its Indian subsidiary and customers, choose governing law and seat, and enforce English court judgments and arbitral awards in India.
- [Data Protection for UK Companies in India: UK GDPR, the DPDP Act and Transfers to India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/data-protection-uk-gdpr-dpdp): How a UK company moves personal data to and from an Indian subsidiary: UK GDPR transfer rules, India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, timelines, and practical contract terms.
- [Documents for an Indian Subsidiary from the UK: Companies House, Notary and Apostille](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/documents-companies-house-apostille): The documents a UK company needs to incorporate an Indian subsidiary, how Companies House papers, notarisation and the UK apostille work, and the mistakes that cost weeks.
- [Selling, Restructuring or Closing an Indian Subsidiary: A Guide for UK Parents](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/exit-and-restructuring): How a UK parent can sell, merge, restructure or close an Indian subsidiary: share sale, slump sale, merger, buyback and winding up, with Indian tax, RBI reporting and the UK substantial shareholding exemption.
- [Funding an Indian Subsidiary from the UK: FEMA, Pricing, Valuation and Form FC-GPR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/funding-and-fema): How a UK parent puts money into an Indian subsidiary legally: equity, convertible preference shares and loans, the fair-value pricing floor, the 60-day allotment rule and Form FC-GPR.
- [Global Capability Centres in India for UK Companies: Models, Regulation and Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/gcc-for-uk-companies): How a UK company can build a captive Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India: models, stages, regulated-firm outsourcing rules, transfer pricing, PE risk, talent and governance.
- [Hiring in India as a UK Employer: Contracts, Payroll, Labour Codes and Share Plans](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/hiring-in-india): How a UK company should hire in India through its subsidiary: contracts, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, the labour codes, payroll, and how to extend share plans to Indian employees.
- [Incorporating an Indian Subsidiary from the UK: A 12-Week Plan](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/incorporation-steps): A week-by-week plan for a UK company to incorporate a wholly owned Indian subsidiary: documents, DSC and DIN, SPICe+, bank account, FC-GPR, first board meeting and the first 90 days.
- [India-UK CETA: What the Trade Agreement Changes for UK Companies Entering India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/india-uk-ceta): What the India-UK CETA means for a UK company that wants to set up, staff or sell through an Indian subsidiary: services access, staff mobility, the Double Contributions Convention and what stays unchanged.
- [India-UK DTAA: Article-by-Article Guide to the Tax Treaty for UK Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/india-uk-dtaa): The India-UK double taxation convention explained article by article from the UK parent's point of view: rates table, permanent establishment, royalties and fees, gains, employees, relief and how to claim.
- [Relocating UK Staff to India: Visas, FRRO Registration, Housing and Day-Count Control](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/relocate-uk-staff): How to move a UK employee to India: employment visa or short-stay visa, CETA intra-corporate transfers, FRRO registration, housing, banking, family and the day-count controls.
- [Getting Money Out of India: Dividends, Fees, Royalties and Loan Repayments to a UK Parent](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/repatriating-profits): The routes a UK parent has for taking money out of its Indian subsidiary, with the Indian tax, UK tax, forms and timing for each route.
- [Subsidiary, Branch, Liaison Office or LLP: Choosing a Structure in India from the UK](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/structure-options): How a UK company should choose between an Indian subsidiary, branch, liaison office, LLP or Employer of Record, and whether to hold it directly or through an intermediate company.
- [Transfer Pricing for UK-Owned Indian Subsidiaries: Documentation, Methods and Audits](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/transfer-pricing): How Indian transfer pricing applies to an Indian subsidiary of a UK group: arm's length pricing, Form 48, documentation, methods, safe harbours, audits and how it differs from the UK regime.
- [UK Employees in India: Tax Treaty, Residence and the Double Contributions Convention](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/uk-employees-in-india-dcc): How the India-UK tax treaty (Articles 15 and 16), Indian tax residence, provident fund and the 2026 India-UK Double Contributions Convention apply to UK employees working in India.
- [UK Parent Obligations for an Indian Subsidiary: CFC Rules, Dividend Exemption and Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/uk-to-india/uk-parent-reporting): The UK-side tax and compliance duties of a parent with an Indian subsidiary: dividend exemption, CFC rules, foreign tax credit, UK transfer pricing, Pillar Two, and the UK bribery and failure-to-prevent-fraud laws.
